t: The Love Boat: Happily Ever After, Have I Got A Job For You, Mr. Smith Goes To Minikula
st: Happily Ever After, Have I Got A Job For You, Mr. Smith Goes To Minikula
d: Captain Stubing gets cold feet on the eve of his wedding and Gopher gets an offer to manage a tropical resort.

t: The Love Boat: The Captain & The Lady / One If By Land... / Centerfold
st: The Captain & The Lady / One If By Land... / Centerfold
d: Bonnie Franklin appears as Capt. Stubing's infuriatingly sarcastic ex-wife with her present spouse, the captain's boss.

t: The Love Boat: Oh, Dale! / The Main Event / A Tasteful Affair
st: Oh, Dale! / The Main Event / A Tasteful Affair
d: In "Oh, Dale!," John Ritter plays a rejected suitor hot on the trail of the girl he loves, who happens to be a heartless fortune-seeker named Joann (Jennifer Shaw).

t: The Love Boat: Ex Plus Y / Graham And Kelly / Golden Agers
st: Ex Plus Y / Graham And Kelly / Golden Agers
d: In "Ex Plus Y," newlyweds Terri and Ron Larson (Loretta "M*A*S*H" Swit and Richard "Soap" Mulligan) are adjusting well until Terri encounters ex-husband Barney (Robert Reed) aboard ship with his lady friend.

t: The Love Boat: Message For Maureen / Acapulco Connection / Gotcha
st: Message For Maureen / Acapulco Connection / Gotcha
d: In "Message for Maureen," a famous female tennis pro (Brenda Benet) confined to a wheelchair as the result of a serious accident, finds herself in a relationship with a sports writer (Bill Bixby) who was once her severest critic.

t: The Love Boat: Help! Murder! / Isaac The Groupie / Mr. Popularity
st: Help! Murder! / Isaac The Groupie / Mr. Popularity
d: In "Help, Murder," Denise and Bret (Michele Lee and David Groh) are a married couple getting away from their three kids for the first time.

t: The Love Boat: The Joker Is Mild / First Time Out / Take My Granddaughter, Please
st: The Joker Is Mild / First Time Out / Take My Granddaughter, Please
d: In "The Joker is Mild," has-been comedian Barry Keyes (Phil Foster) abuses his family tie with cruise director Julie in an astonishing attempt to make a comeback.

t: The Love Boat: The Identical Problem / Julie's Old Flame / The Jinx
st: The Identical Problem / Julie's Old Flame / The Jinx
d: In "The Identical Problem," twins Helen and Ellen (both played by Diana "Soap" Canova) pretend to be one person, which nearly drives Doc crazy because Helen is warm, Ellen is cold and Doc is feeling amorous.

t: The Love Boat: The Understudy / Married Singles / Lost & Found
st: The Understudy / Married Singles / Lost & Found
d: A boy befriends a couple that recently lost its young son. A trainee schemes to steal Julie's job. A bickering married couple takes the cruise and stays in separate cabins...next door to each other.

t: The Love Boat: Romance Roulette / The Captain's Captain / Dog's Life
st: Romance Roulette / The Captain's Captain / Dog's Life
d: The presence of the captain's demanding father leaves the entire crew on edge. A dog traps a passenger in his cabin. Three friends reunite on board the ship and try to meet men through an unusual game. (TV-PG)

t: The Love Boat: Dear Beverly / The Strike / Special Delivery
st: Dear Beverly / The Strike / Special Delivery
d: An advice columnist neglects her husband to devote all her time to her fans, prompting him to seek affection elsewhere. A man with a negative history with Capt. Stubing fills in for the ailing chef.

t: The Love Boat: Lonely At The Top / Silent Night / Divorce Me, Please
st: Lonely At The Top / Silent Night / Divorce Me, Please
d: In a Christmas-themed cruise, the captain worries about how to effectively lead his ship but be a friend to his crew as well. A married couple who outwardly appear happy and in love are both desperate for the other person to give them a divorce.

t: The Love Boat: The Old Man And The Runaway / A Fine Romance / The Painters
st: The Old Man And The Runaway / A Fine Romance / The Painters
d: A crotchety old man and a teenage runaway form an unlikely friendship. Julie grows frustrated when an old friend of her brother's repeatedly rejects her advances without explanation.

t: The Love Boat: Family Reunion / Cinderella Story / Too Hot To Handle
st: Family Reunion / Cinderella Story / Too Hot To Handle
d: A woman who believes her departed dad was a noble sea captain forms an attachment for a devilish old purser; a newlywed couple are prevented by dislocated backs, sunburn, and even poison ivy from enjoying their honeymoon.

t: The Love Boat: Isaac's Double Standard / Chimpanzeeshines / One More Time
st: Isaac's Double Standard / Chimpanzeeshines / One More Time
d: Isaac's possessive mother becomes jealous of her son's lady friend, while he objects to his mom sharing a cabin with her latest boyfriend; a divorced comedy team is too busy making jokes to admit they miss each other.

t: The Love Boat: The Caper / Eyes Of Love / Hollywood Royalty / Masquerade - Parts 1 & 2
st: The Caper / Eyes Of Love / Hollywood Royalty / Masquerade - Parts 1 & 2
d: Millionaire superstars Roz and Bill (Michele Lee and Fernando Lamas) have remarried and are celebrating their newest honeymoon aboard the Pacific Princess in "Hollywood Royalty."
